notes.title: XBPlay Update: Ending Support
notes.notes:
I wanted to share an important update with you all. After a lot of thought, I’ve decided I will no longer be able to support XBPlay.
[p align="start"]This has been such a fun and rewarding project, and it’s only been possible because of all of you. Your feedback, ideas, and encouragement over the years have meant so much to me. I never imagined XBPlay would reach so many people, and I’m truly grateful it could be part of your gaming experience.
[p align="start"]The app will remain available until Sep. 30, at which point I will unpublish it.
[p align="start"]Happy gaming :)
